title: Parseval identity for Boolean functions
statement: Let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$ be a Boolean function, and regard its values as real numbers. The sum, over all subsets $S\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$, of the squares of its Fourier coefficients is $1$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on the sign cube of dimension $n$
